Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Dynise Espeleta DBA Upside Crenshaw Holding, LLC to host a Drive-In
  Movie at 2930 W. Imperial Hwy in (Parking Lot)-Crenshaw Plaza, on Thursday,
  September 10, 2020 from 5:00 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. (Activity No.00298717)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Anthony Holt DBA Pull Up Neighbor Foundation, to host a Pull Up Neighbor Grab
  and Go giveaway at 700 Warren Ln. - Edward Vincent Park, on Saturday, September
  19, 2020 from 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00298720)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Laverne Smith DBA Consortium for Belizean Development, Inc.to host Belize
  Independence Day at 217 Nutwood St.- in the Street in Front of Little Belize
  Restaurant, on Sunday, September 20, 2020 from 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. (Activity
  No. 00298603)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Wanzel King DBA Beyond the Rim Girls Club to host A Sunday Market Place in the
  Wood at 110 S. La Brea Ave - In the One Stop Parking Lot, on Sunday, September
  27, 2020 from 7:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00297917)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
